question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: an MCP tools/call of search_cloudflare_documentation with the query 'how does Workers billing work', sent alone with MCP-Protocol-Version 2025-06-18, no session id and no prior handshake on the connection; section (P5) of the artifact, sent 18:10:22Z, shown cut at 6,000 of 37,280 bytes

decoded.result: a JSON-RPC result on the event stream carrying documentation chunks, each with its source URL, title and text: the first is https://developers.cloudflare.com/ai-gateway/features/unified-billing/ ('Unified Billing'), the same first chunk the 2026-09-23 reading got
decoded.no-challenge: no www-authenticate header and no refusal of any kind; the call was answered on its merits
decoded.session: no session id was sent with this call and the server answered it anyway, as on 2026-09-23
decoded.not-measured: the second tool, migrate_pages_to_workers_guide, was not called; the response was not read past its first chunk for relevance
decoded.why-re-sent: Re-sent 2026-10-09 because the record of this request from 2026-09-23 (p-20260923-cloudflare-mcp-docs-tools-call-keyless) was filed before this prober kept transcripts and names no artifact; this one does. Nothing measured changed.

finding: Cloudflare's Documentation MCP server still answers a keyless tools/call with real documentation: search_cloudflare_documentation returned source-attributed chunks from developers.cloudflare.com to a caller with no credentials, no account and no session id, sixteen days after the 2026-09-23 reading and with the same first chunk. This is the measurement the entry's noAccountNeeded cell rests on, now with a transcript that carries the request and its sent time. Everything here is one query to one of the server's two tools from one IP; it does not measure rate limits, the second tool, or the quality of the answer.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -i -m 25 -X POST https://docs.mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search_cloudflare_documentation","arguments":{"query":"how does Workers billing work"}}}'
